exposure: features of myometrial defects (depth, pattern, location - anterior/lateral/inferior)
distance of defect from internal cervical os
outcome: Accuracy of 3D models compared to surgical and pathological findings
potential for selecting patients for uterine-conserving surgery
cohort: The study included patients with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS); n=4 for initial 3D modeling and n=14 for subsequent validation.
finding: Three-dimensional models of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) accurately correlate with surgical and pathological findings regarding depth, pattern of invasion, location, and bladder involvement, with inferior defects associated with increased blood loss and increased distance from cervix associated with reduced blood loss.
